<div align="center">
<h1 id="vue3admin" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="2">vue3Admin</h1>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="4">这个模板应该能帮助你开始在Vite中使用Vue3进行开发。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="6">参照vue3-element-admin，<a href="https://www.youlai.tech/docs/" data-href="https://www.youlai.tech/docs/" rel="noopener nofollow">点击查看官网</a>。技术栈包括TypeScript、JSX、Vue Router、Pinia。 UI框架采用<a href="https://element-plus.org/zh-CN/" data-href="https://element-plus.org/zh-CN/" rel="noopener nofollow">element-plus 2.14.7</a></p>
<div class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="9">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<h2 id="project-setup初始化" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="11">Project Setup（初始化）</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 创建名为vue3Admin的项目
pnpm create vue@latest vue3Admin</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 初始化项目选择
pnpm create vue@latest vue3Admin
TypeScript → Yes
JSX → No（除非你需要，例如动态性极高的场景。比如你要写一个高度可配置的动态表单生成器。属于进阶选择。）
Vue Router → 按需（本项目Yes）
Pinia → 按需 （本项目Yes）
Vitest </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> E2E → No（基础脚手架可先跳过）
ESLint </span>/ Prettier → 按需 （本项目Yes）</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 进入项目目录
cd vue3Admin</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="install-dependencies安装依赖" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="34">Install Dependencies（安装依赖）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 安装依赖
pnpm </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="compile-and-hot-reload-for-development开发编译含热重启" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="41">Compile and Hot-Reload for Development（开发编译，含热重启）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 开发编译，含热重启
pnpm dev</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 id="type-check-compile-and-minify-for-production生产编译含检查压缩" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="48">Type-Check, Compile and Minify for Production（生产编译，含检查、压缩）</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 生产编译，含检查、压缩
pnpm build</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="55">&nbsp;</div>
<div align="center">
<h1 id="开发实录" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="57">开发实录</h1>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="59">这是一个空白模板，从零开始搭建后台系统。</p>
<div class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="61">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<h1 id="项目结构" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="63">项目结构</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">vue3Admin
├── index.html
├── README.md
├── .</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.development
├── .</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.production
├── public
│   ├── favicon.ico
│   └──
├── src
│   ├── router
│   │   └── index.ts
│   ├── views
│   │   ├── Home.vue
│   │   ├── </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">login</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   │   │   ├── index.vue
│   │   │   └── components
│   │   </span>|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       ├── Register.vue

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="入口-html-文件" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="87">入口 HTML 文件</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="89"><code>index.html</code> 是 Vite 项目的入口 HTML 文件，也是浏览器加载应用时第一个请求的页面。</p>
<h4 id="网站标题title" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="91">网站标题（title）</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> index.html </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>%VITE_APP_TITLE%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="98">VITE_APP_TITLE在.env文件中进行<code>全局</code>配置。本项目更多配置方式见<a href="https://file+.vscode-resource.vscode-cdn.net/Users/peony/Documents/wgh/test/vue3Admin/README.md#%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AEenv" data-href="#%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AEenv">环境变量配置</a>。</p>
<h4 id="网站图标favicon" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="100">网站图标（favicon）</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> index.html </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">link </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">rel</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="icon"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> href</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="/favicon.ico"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4 id="网站描述description" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="107">网站描述（description）</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> index.html </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">meta </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="description"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> content</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="%VITE_APP_DESCRIPTION%"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span></pre>
</div>

<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> index.html </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 全局样式 </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="环境变量配置env" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="123">环境变量配置（.env）</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="125">.env文件是 Vite 项目的环境变量配置文件，用于在不同的开发、测试、生产环境中设置不同的配置。更多配置方式见官方文档<a href="https://vitejs.dev/config/#env-variables" data-href="https://vitejs.dev/config/#env-variables" rel="noopener nofollow">环境变量配置</a>。</p>
<h4 id="开发环境envdevelopment" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="127">开发环境（.env.development）</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># .<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.development
VITE_APP_TITLE</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Vue3Admin
VITE_APP_DESCRIPTION</span>=这是一个Vue3Admin项目</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4 id="生产环境envproduction" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="135">生产环境（.env.production）</h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># .<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">env</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.production
VITE_APP_TITLE</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Vue3Admin
VITE_APP_DESCRIPTION</span>=这是一个Vue3Admin项目</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="应用入口文件maints配置" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="143">应用入口文件<code>main.ts</code>配置</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="145">main.ts(路径:/src/main.ts) 是 Vue 3 + Vite 项目的应用入口文件，负责创建 Vue 应用实例、安装全局插件、挂载根组件。它和 index.html 分工明确：index.html 提供页面骨架和入口脚本引用，main.ts 则是真正的应用启动逻辑。</p>
<h2 id="路由配置" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="163">路由配置</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="165">文件路径:src/router/index.ts</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>import { createRouter, createWebHistory, type RouteRecordRaw } from 'vue-router'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 静态路由</span>
export const constantRouters: RouteRecordRaw[] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
  {
    path: </span>'/'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    name: </span>'Home'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    component: () </span>=&gt; import('@/views/Home.vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
  },
  {
    path: </span>'/login'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    name: </span>'Login'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    component: () </span>=&gt; import('@/views/login/index.vue'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
  }
]

const router </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> createRouter({
  history: createWebHistory(import.meta.env.BASE_URL),
  routes: constantRouters,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 刷新时，滚动条位置还原</span>
  scrollBehavior: () =&gt; ({ left: 0, top: 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }),
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 路由守卫</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> beforeEach: (to, from, next) =&gt; {}</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span> router</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="home首页配置" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="177">home(首页)配置</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># src/views/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Home.vue
</span>&lt;template&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;
        &lt;h1&gt;花花工作室&lt;/h1&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;欢迎来到花花工作室！&lt;/p&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;
        &lt;!-- 登录 --&gt;
        &lt;el-button type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @click=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">handleLogin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;登录&lt;/el-button&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { useRouter } from </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">vue-router</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
const router </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useRouter();

const handleLogin </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 跳转到登录页面</span>
    router.push(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/login</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
};
</span>&lt;/script&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="login登录页配置" class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="181">login(登录页)配置</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># src/views/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">login</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">index.vue
</span>&lt;template&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;登录页面&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;!-- 登录 --&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;用户名：admin&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;密码：<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">123456</span>&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;!-- 注册 --&gt;
    &lt;el-button type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @click=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">register</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;注册&lt;/el-button&gt;
    &lt;!-- 忘记密码 --&gt;
    &lt;el-button type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @click=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">forgetPwd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;忘记密码&lt;/el-button&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { useRouter } from </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">vue-router</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
const router </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useRouter();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注册</span>
const register = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    router.push(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./components/Register.vue</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 忘记密码</span>
const forgetPwd = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    router.push(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/ForgetPwd</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}
</span>&lt;/script&gt;</pre>
</div>

<h3 id="register注册页配置" class="code-line code-active-line" dir="auto" data-line="185">register(注册页)配置</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># src/views/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">login</span>/components/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Register.vue
</span>&lt;!-- 注册组件 --&gt;
&lt;template&gt;
    &lt;div class=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">register-container</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
        &lt;h2&gt;注册&lt;/h2&gt;
        &lt;form @submit.prevent=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">handleRegister</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
            &lt;div class=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
                &lt;label <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">username</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;用户名&lt;/label&gt;
                &lt;input type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">username</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> v-model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">username</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> required /&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
                &lt;label <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;邮箱&lt;/label&gt;
                &lt;input type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> v-model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> required /&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
                &lt;label <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;密码&lt;/label&gt;
                &lt;input type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> v-model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">password</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> required /&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;button type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">submit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;注册&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;/form&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { ref } from </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">vue</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

const username </span>= ref(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
const email </span>= ref(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
const password </span>= ref(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

const handleRegister </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理注册逻辑</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
